solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/thousand-separator/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1556. Thousand Separator

Given an integer n, add a dot (".") as the thousands separator and return it in string format.

Example 1:

Input: n = 987
Output: "987"

Example 2:

Input: n = 1234
Output: "1.234"

Constraints:

    0 <= n <= 2^31 - 1
"""


class Solution:
    def thousandSeparator(self, n: int) -> str:
        s = str(n)[::-1]
        parts = [s[i : i + 3] for i in range(0, len(s), 3)]
        return ".".join(part[::-1] for part in parts[::-1])


sol = Solution()

print(sol.thousandSeparator(987))  # "987"

assert sol.thousandSeparator(987) == "987"
assert sol.thousandSeparator(1234) == "1.234"
